feature_idea: Worktree GC, delete half (herdr-routines issue 012, docs/process/issues/012-worktree-gc-delete-half.md). Opt-in deletion of what herdr-routines gc --dry-run lists — merged or orphaned auto/<name>-<ts> branches and their worktrees. Nothing is ever removed automatically: a scheduled tool that deletes branches unattended is explicitly not wanted. Deletion is a human-invoked herdr-routines gc --delete (or --prune) acting on the dry-run output. Acceptance: gc --delete removes exactly the branches/worktrees the paired --dry-run lists, and nothing else. Refuses to run from an unattended/scheduled context (interactive-only, or requires an explicit --yes). A branch that is not merged is never deleted without an explicit --force-style opt-in.
